tasks.label: Python: ci-checks
args:
set -euo pipefail
cd ${workspaceFolder}/cli
poetry install
poetry run ruff check .
poetry run ruff format --check .
poetry run mypy src
poetry run pytest --cov=src/radiant --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing
cd ${workspaceFolder}/server
poetry install
poetry run ruff check .
poetry run ruff format --check .
poetry run mypy src
poetry run pytest --cov=src/radiant_server --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing

tasks.label: Frontend: ci-checks
tasks.command: npm ci && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build

tasks.label: Docs: build (CI parity)
tasks.command: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e ../cli && pip install -e ../server && pip install sphinx furo sphinx-autodoc-typehints && sphinx-build -b html . _build/html -W

tasks.label: Security: bandit
args:
set -euo pipefail
cd ${workspaceFolder}/cli
poetry install
poetry run bandit -r src/ -f json -o bandit-report.json
cd ${workspaceFolder}/server
poetry install
poetry run bandit -r src/ -f json -o bandit-report.json
